notes.title: Update 0.10.0.1261 - Introducing BattlEye Anti-Cheat, Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/552ece052930dd28e0a5ef56fd4ec6a1efc6a59c.jpg[/img]

Hey Folks,

In our ongoing efforts to deal with reports of cheats in DUCKSIDE, with today's update we have changed our anticheat system and integrated BattlEye, a leading anti-cheat system used in a number of the most popular competitive shooters.

BattlEye runs at the kernel level, allowing it to proactively detect and ban cheaters in real time while staying light on system resources. It also provides custom security solutions tailored for DUCKSIDE, ensuring deeper protection against evolving cheats.

We’re working closely with BattlEye to identify and remove cheaters faster than we were able to previously, which will result in a much more enjoyable and fair experience for everyone.

Let us know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell us what you'd like to see added to the game in the future. We've got a bunch of cool stuff in the works, and can't wait to share what's coming up with you all!

notes.title: January Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/054833098f40c76975ec3be85321e281bd4e78a3.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

We’re seeing out the first month of the year with a new update for DUCKSIDE, which includes the implementation of the first iteration of one of our roadmap goals; weapon durability, alongside a bunch of balancing tweaks, QOL improvements and general optimization.

Check out the full update notes below! 

[h1]What’s New:[/h1]
 
[h3]Durability feature for melee weapons[/h3]

The “Durability” feature is introduced for melee weapons. We will continue to extend this feature and fine-tune the ‘durability’ levels, while also adding a repair option in the near future.

[h3]Explosive Charge Placements:[/h3]

Players can now throw small and large explosive charges onto walls from a distance, similar to the satchel charge mechanic in other games. This replaces the previous method of directly placing C4 on walls, adding a new layer of strategy and skill to breaching tactics.

[h3]Added a second exit to the submarine[/h3] 

Previously, the submarine had only one exit, making it easy to camp. A second exit has been introduced to improve balance and reduce camping.

[h3]Improved NPC AI[/h3]

NPCs now attempt to take cover behind walls, crates, and other objects instead of standing still or running unpredictably. 

[h3]Scope Sensitivity Options [/h3]

A new sensitivity setting has been added specifically for scoped weapons. Players can now fine-tune their mouse sensitivity separately for collimator sights and 4x scopes, allowing for more precise aiming customization.

[h3]In-Game Steam Ban Feature [/h3]

Administrators and Moderators can now issue Steam game bans directly from the in-game admin panel.

[h3]Enhanced Player Marker System[/h3]
 [list]
[*] The team marker system has been overhauled to reduce confusion:
[*] Players can now place one group-visible marker using Ctrl + Left Mouse Button
[*] Each player can set up to 5 personal markers
[*] Team leaders have the ability to remove group markers placed by other team members
[/list]
[h3]General improvements:[/h3]

Implemented some visual fixes and general optimization 

[hr][/hr]
Let us know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell us what you'd like to see added to the game in the future! 

Don't forget to join the conversation over on Discord and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:

notes.title: The Christmas Update is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/cca28f6c38c1210e2eca402a7f93cbcd4ba0151b.jpg[/img]

[quote]The festive season is upon us! So for their first Christmas on the DUCKSIDE archipelago, the Ducks are celebrating it in style with a Christmas Update! 

Quacked with new features, holiday-themed items, a brand new monument and more. Let’s unwrap the highlights! Read through the end for the full patch notes![/quote]

[h3]New Monument:[/h3]

Somehow, someone got a submarine stranded in the middle of the desert. Gross incompetence of whoever was captaining that submarine aside, it holds some valuable loot for anyone brave enough to venture to its heart and extract it…

[h3]New Events:[/h3]

Get ready for some merry mayhem!

1️⃣ [b]Christmas Carol Ghost Event: [/b]

Who ya gonna call? Not Scrooge, that’s for sure. The Ghostly Ducks of Christmas yet to come are haunting bases across the archipelago. 

Drops new gatherable resource
Snow Piece: Used for crafting Xmas themed items!

2️⃣ [b]Santa’s Sled Shooting Event:[/b]

Santa (or a feathered non-union equivalent) is visiting to spread joy and cultivate carnage.
While shooting "Santa's” sleigh would usually get you put pretty high up on the naughty list, it is the most efficient way of getting your hands on his loot…

The bravest ducks may also find even rarer loot in the sleigh itself…  

[h3]New Cosmetics & Decorations[/h3]

[b]Santa Hat:[/b] I mean, what other kind of hat do you expect at Christmas…?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/f80221d440a3c613bc6416afd31092b26cdb6629.png[/img]
[b]Deer Antlers:[/b] Become an honorary member of Santa's reindeer alongside Rudolph, Donner, Dancer and whatever the other ones are called!

[b]Snowman[/b] Keep a cool head in even the toughest situations! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/8543806c8bf649a2352d43c17ca14b72dc8d1451.png[/img]
[b]Krampus Hat:[/b] For all the ducks out there that still enjoy christmas but wanna maintain their edgy and mysterious persona.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/5f802f8b6045abe98310665a940a84280dac1538.jpg[/img]
[b]Door Skin:[/b] Nothing says “It’s Christmas” like a wreath on the door of a base that you’re about to turn to rubble.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/44a41d18c8147ae27d8d2855debe7f7fb44e0aa0.jpg[/img]
[b]Fireplace[/b] Warm those webbed feet by the fire as you await the arrival of santa (or a raider) with a Christmas Fireplace
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/bc6af1af183ff7bf6e1da9633939b8b08afa2ee5.jpg[/img]
[b]And more! :[/b] Christmas lights, candy cane weapons, streamer shotguns and Christmas tree shrines can also be crafted and found throughout the archipelago! 

[h3]New Buildable:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/bdaf0c225b66fab980dbd9cf88b6bd42ee2d0e5c.png[/img]

Snowman: Ever wanted to blow up a snowman with a rocket launcher? Of course you have, and now you can! 

(Please note that you don’t actually get anything out of it other than the satisfaction of having blown up a snowman with a rocket launcher)

Snowmen can be built by default.

[hr][/hr]

With this update, we have completed the first phase of our Roadmap and have updated it to reflect our goals for the coming months, which you can see below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/ad19a2394c7c8f1713c6cc293e6d468b20d3484a.jpg[/img]

Also, we have put together a player satisfaction survey to help us understand our players experiences with the game, what could be improved, what you would most like to see added and your overall opinion of DUCKSIDE, and we would appreciate it if you could take 10 minutes to help us out here by filling it out

https://forms.gle/WbS5NFsUMq94gEES6

   [list]

notes.title: DUCKSIDE | October Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/db73930cd3cfb8b28c10b5ed164131c20abaf045.jpg[/img]

[quote]Hey all!

It’s been just over a month since we launched DUCKSIDE into Early Access and we’re absolutely blown away by the response we’ve seen so far!

Today, we’re going to update you on what’s going on at the DUCKSIDE HQ, with some details about upcoming major additions, our next patch and some organizational improvements we’ve made to improve the player experience in DUCKSIDE…[/quote]

[u][h2]Addressing cheaters/hackers[/h2][/u]

First off, we have now established [b]a dedicated cheat prevention admin team[/b] to manage player reports. Previously, we had no dedicated personnel to handle the deluge of reports we had been receiving, with the team members instead dealing with them on an ad-hoc basis. With the introduction of our new admin team, we are in a much better position to address player reports, cheats and hackers in a more organized and timely manner.

[u][h2]Immediate focuses:[/h2][/u]

[b]Implementation of a new Anti-cheat system[/b]

EAC has been holding the fort for us since our first beta all the way back in April, but there are some essential features we need for this style of game that the platform doesn’t offer at this time. So in the interest of improving the security of the game and maintaining our community's enjoyment of DUCKSIDE, we will soon be implementing a new anti-cheat system which has proven successful in other similar titles that we hope will be more suited to our needs.

[b]New monument - Stranded submarine[/b]

The Early Access release saw the introduction of the Oil Rig, which marked a new approach to how we design our monuments and is something we will be continuing with our next major monument: The Stranded Submarine.

Work is well underway and we hope to have this introduced either before the end of the year, or early 2025. We will keep you updated on our efforts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/1252f96b55b84c7bcc81f26ec459dc00b63894be.png[/img]

[b]Tool durability system:[/b]

At this moment in time, tools don’t degrade with use, making eco raiding a lengthy but extremely viable option for anyone who wants to save their resources and are willing to dedicate their time to it. The team are working to implement a weapon durability system that will ideally shift the raiding emphasis back to designated raiding equipment, requiring more skill, planning and rarer resources.

[b]Thanksgiving Update/Event[/b]

These ducks love a national holiday, especially if it means that other birds have to deal with the humans wrath for a few days....

New hats, new skins, new base decoration items and more are coming to DUCKSIDE in celebration of Thanksgiving this November! 

Check out some concept art 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/4d742e7076e3cab6fe052e28b20c119e97ffc3c9.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Next Update[/h2][/u]
Finally, let’s take an Early look at what's planned for the next upcoming patch which we’ve built around some of the most common reports and feedback we’ve received from players over the last few weeks.

[b]We’re hoping to release this update later this week or early next:[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug with placing a floor door
[*] Fixing a bug with determining stability in construction (objects could hang in the air after destruction).
[*] Fixing a bug with a triangular floor, where it was impossible to place walls under an improved floor.
[*] Fixing dismantling triangular doors without an idol.
[*] Fixing dismantling objects (e.g., workbenches) not giving crafting kits in the base without an idol.
[*] Fixing that there was no animation of a character's shot when aiming for a local player.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Shot validation - fewer missed shots.
[*] Removed the check for player spawn, so they are not teleported to a random spawn during a collision.
[*] Molotov will now damage sleeping ducks.
[*] Adding zoom while aiming.
[*] Base registration improvements.
[/list]
[b]Anti-Cheat and Reporting[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be able to spam reports.
[*] Anti-cheat will now show report ID, allowing users to appeal to EAC with it.
[/list]
[b]Map and Content Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Map - adding 2 cave systems.
[/list]
[b]Weapon Modifications[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon modifications: bullet speed increase, recoil change.
[/list]

This is a tentative list, and we will be monitoring player feedback to further identify anything that we can resolve in time for the patch. So if you have anything you feel needs urgently addressing, please don’t hesitate to let us know!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/d453e48085c895dea4afb2f9476e6c25baf314ed.png[/img]

The spirit of Halloween has quite literally swept throughout the DUCKSIDE archipelago as "Operation: Night Of The Living Ducks" has been activated.

Base decorations, new hats, hat crafting, sneaking mechanics, vengeful spirits, bat infested buildings, creepy merchants and some highly requested quality of life additions have dropped just in time for Halloween!  

On top of that [b]all weekly servers have now been wiped[/b], bi-weekly servers will be wiped alongside weekly servers next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/6ac7e86272735a51d13b3ea79613db4ad124d7bd.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h8ZB630.gif[/img]

Vengeful spirits of duck-like creatures have begun to haunt bases across the archipelago! Why are they here? Why do they look kinda duckish? Were they previous inhabitants of this island? Why can we make hats out of the goo that comes out of them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/f7875ae81fe62dd86471603ad35709ae43f138b5.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bHqox3S.gif[/img]

With all these ghosts floating about, everyone is going to be very wary of anything that goes bump in the night, so once again, ducks have had to adapt.

Sneak silently by holding [CTRL] when moving and catch your enemies completely unaware.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/77ad78f61f072e802dd9b5923f3eb3a777cc0e9d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/4cb36b0c3d4691bc8abb5e1eeaeead6d010819de.jpg[/img]

While humans typically outfit themselves head to toe in spooky outfits during Halloween, duck tailors are hard to find these days, so they tend to just stick a spooky hat on and call it a day. 

This Halloween, 2 hats can now be crafted at the workstation from the ectoplasm that your ghostly new neighbors drop upon extermination - A pumpkin hate and a Witch Hat! These hats can be looted from other ducks bodies if you're feeling particularly lazy.

3 new hats have also been added to the default options, Eagle, Winter Hat and Rusty Mask! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/c07b5d6d4966e2123f218c35ff7218cef149ae54.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XL6VPcf.gif[/img]

Impress unwanted visitors before they get blasted into a cloud of feathers by a shotgun trap with a variety of Halloween themed base decorations, including banners, skull lamps, tombstones and door murals!

A new system has been introduced to allow you to place decorations within your territory, and this will continue to be expanded with future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/6712e38d34a117d51893c425be050af09bc0228e.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/leunojG.gif[/img]

Even the merchant is getting in on the Halloween fun, having decorated his abode with all sorts of spooky trinkets. For some reason he also has a serious bat infestation problem now and his eyes glow green, but that's a problem for him, an exterminator and his doctor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/618d1202a954d6b66c9edfca48cca944ba86266c.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uUhw5NA.gif[/img]

Humans seem to have a new skincare routing as they are now [i]literally glowing[/i] at night, while the spirits of ducks have begun physically leaving their body upon death, which is nice to look at, but not so nice to think too deeply about.   

[h2]And some not so Halloween-y but still cool changes:[/h2]

[h3]Building into terrain:[/h3]

You can now [b]partially[/b] build into the terrain and through small obstructions! 

[h3]Workbench makeover:[/h3]

Workbench 1, 2 & 3 have new models

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability to build in and under the terrain has been removed
[*] Oil Rig has been heavily optimized
[/list]

notes.title: DUCKSIDE | July Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/5db0ea884e0f40113f1f231c1c6b5e29b6c2febe.jpg[/img]
[quote]It’s been a few weeks since the second DUCKSIDE beta concluded now, so we thought it would be a great time to update you all on what’s going on behind the scenes and some of our plans for the coming months![/quote]

[hr][/hr]

While we’ve shared in our previous announcement some of our short term focuses (much of which is now either complete or well in development) today, we’re going to share some of the longer term development plans and content that we’ll be working on to bring us through to release:

[h2]New Biomes[/h2]

Grass and trees are great and all, but would ducks even bother migrating if they had some massive desert expanses just a few kilometers down the road, or glacial planes on the other side of a local mountain? Who knows, we’re not duck experts, we’re game developers and we want to add some cool new areas for the ducks to explore without them getting too tired, so we’re going to do that. 

Alongside the visual changes we talked about in our last development update, DUCKSIDE will be seeing some major visual improvements and additional natural diversity over the coming months!

[h2]New Monuments[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/249d41886b4d8b33ea8db075c07e0c1e1848cfa5.jpg[/img]

The humans are busy building some new stuff to die in at the hands of some recently sentience-imbued ducks, even going so far as to build off shore now, like that’s going to deter flying creatures that love water... 

But yeah, we’re working on some cool new POIs to explore, and we’d love to get some suggestions from you folks for additional ones that might fit into this world! 

[h2]Mixing Table[/h2]

Ducks only have so much time in the day, so spending that time crafting items en masse is time that could be spent killing things or building cool nests wasted. 

Therefore, in the interest of spending more time killing and building, we are introducing a mixing table to speed up the crafting of large amounts of items.

[h2]Character Controller Rework[/h2]

Telepathic ducks really drive home how crazy the situation has gotten over on the DUCKSIDE Archipelago, but having guns floating around the ducks head detracts a little from the gritty, realistic and somber tone we're going for with this game, so in the interest of being taken seriously once award season comes around, we're working to have the ducks actually hold their weapons.

[h2]Shotgun Trap[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LtRdw0V.gif[/img]

Trespassing is a crime, and crimes should result in consequences. We feel that being blown to smithereens unexpectedly is a suitable consequence for ducks breaking into your house, so we’ve added shotgun traps to the game.

If you’re a nice, law abiding duck, you won’t have to worry about these too much. If you’re the kind of duck that broke into my house and stole all my metal fragments and my crossbow during the last beta, you’re the reason this happened and you should feel bad.

[h2]And more![/h2]

Obviously, these are just some of the cooler things we’re working on but we’re also coming up with new ideas everyday, and working on a ton of other awesome stuff that we’ll share when the time is right!

[h2]DUCKSIDE when?![/h2]

Finally, the question you folks have been asking since roughly 0.36s after the last beta ended: “When can we play DUCKSIDE again?”

Well, we're working away on the next build of the game as we speak and of course are now making some plans on how to get all your feedback on the latest changes and additions ahead of the official launch, so stay tuned for news!

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0uXkJC.gif[/img]

Don't forget to join the conversation over on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]Discord[/url] and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:

[/list][/i]
See you in the skies, very soon!

notes.title: The DUCKSIDE Beta has now finished | A look to the future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/3e088ebd264d053f1dd5fb3e25a4a5255533f46d.jpg[/img]

[quote]Hello Everyone,

We've had an amazing three weeks on DUCKSIDE, thanks to the hard work of our development team and the incredible success of the Steam Next Fest. With over 200,000 ducks joining the flock and an unexpected meteor collision, we've now successfully wrapped up the second BETA for DUCKSIDE.

We want to extend our thanks to all of you who participated. Your feedback, suggestions, insights, and positivity have been invaluable in helping us improve, develop, and grow the game over the last few weeks. It has been a fantastic journey working with all of you once again, and we can't wait to see you all in game again soon! [/quote]

[hr][/hr]
And of course, with the culmination the beta, we thought now would be the perfect time to share some of our plans for the future of DUCKSIDE, so today we're going to detail some of the near future development goals

[h2]Nature/Environment Art Overhaul[/h2]

We love nature, Ducks love nature, and we want to create world that both of us can (not so peacefully) co-exist in and enjoy! So with that in mind, we're currently exploring an overhaul of the natural environments on the DUCKSIDE Archipelago to both improve and build upon the visual aesthetic of the game alongside facilitating a wider range of gameplay experiences and play styles. 

Something we're keen to avoid is going too realistic. The world of DUCKSIDE already has a lot of character and vibrancy, and that's something we want to maintain. Our goal instead is to flesh it out with more lush, diverse and immersive areas in keeping with the stylized look that DUCKSIDE is known for.

Below, we've shared the current art style, and a visualization of our concepts for improving the world, alongside some ideas and details about our reasoning and vision:

[b]Trees:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lusher and darker for better composition and separation from the ground.
[*] Increased quantity, with birches for color contrast and younger trees for realism and diversity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/70a706ddfe3f37b727be003600fb66e4fb752dd4.jpg[/img]
[b]Grass and bushes:[/b]
[list]
[*] More diverse grass to create a dynamic landscape.
[*] Additional bushes to complement tree compositions, especially in forest areas.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/8ef22287c15c5a7318205d0eae1ef08962c3c6f7.jpg[/img]
[b]Cliffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimalist texture with less tiling, contrasting nicely with green grass and dark water.
[*] Rocky shores and interesting rock formations, including bridge-like shapes and tunnel-like holes for visual appeal.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/1b2ef622c341be027ecd4948c3a9fb77d69dafc0.png[/img]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shores should be made of sand, dirt, or cliffs, not grass.
[*] Additional adjustments are planned for further enhancement.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/07fb23fe796adfb5b0eb8708c75f2f159f5273dd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Base Defense Mechanics[/h2]
Over the course of the beta we identified that base raids were both far too common, and far too easy for anyone with the adequate firepower or equipment due to a lack of defensive mechanisms being currently available. With that, the team have begun formulating ideas for further base defense systems, starting with turrets which we hope to have implemented ahead of the next public hands on of the game. This will ensure your base remains protected even when you're not logged in.

[h2]Resource Balance Overhaul [/h2]
We are reworking how resources are gathered, spent, and valued in-game. Currently, resource prices are set around a base of 10, with items costing, for example, 15 or 40 units. We aim to adjust these prices, introducing a degree of inflation to provide greater flexibility in rewards and overall gameplay experience.

[h2]Expanded Clothing and Armor Options [/h2]
Customisation is a request we see coming up a lot from our players, so we are expanding our crafting system to include trousers, in addition to jackets, with specific attributes that will further aid players in specific situations. The main goal here is to enhance customization and make crafting prices more meaningful and balanced.

[h2]Weapon Balance Adjustments[/h2] 
Nobody likes seeing every enemy kitted up with whatever weapon is dominating the "meta" at that particular point in time, so we are in the process of fine-tuning the balance of weapon damage. Some weapons will see an increase in power, while others will be adjusted downwards to ensure a fair and engaging combat experience and multiple viable options for combat engagements. 

[h2]Potential New Weapons[/h2] 
If time permits, we plan to introduce new weapons to the game. The specific types of weapons are still under consideration, but they will be designed to enhance gameplay variety and excitement.

[h2]Anti-Cheat Measures[/h2] 
We are exploring alternate anti-cheat systems as we speak, with the aim being to provide a more secure and fair gaming environment for all players. No decisions have been made on this front, but we hope to come to a decision ahead of the next hands-on of the game for the public.

[h2]And more![/h2]
Obviously, there's much more than this in the pipeline, but these are some of our immediate focuses for the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more news on what to expect from the future of DUCKSIDE!
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0uXkJC.gif[/img]

Don't forget to join the conversation over on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]Discord[/url] and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDUCKSIDE]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/playduckside/]Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Duckside/]Reddit[/url]
[/list][/i]

Another huge thanks to everyone who took part in the beta!

See you in the skies!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VbaNL8rvkMw;full][/previewyoutube]

[quote]We heard you'd had a distinct lack of ducks in your life the last couple of months, so obviously, it's our duty to change that.

So, with that in mind... The second DUCKSIDE Beta is now live and available for everyone to play![/quote]

[b]In order to access the beta, all you need to do is head over to the Steam page, scroll down to "DUCKSIDE Demo" and click "Download" and the game will be added to your account.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/5607331d166c65e6d3d7bd0c71114256c55f038f.png[/img]

Since the first beta, we've been hard at work developing the game, analyzing your feedback, suggestions and ideas (of which there was A LOT) and working out the best ways to improve the overall experience for our players. So this Beta has launched with a ton of new content, additions, fixes and improvements, much of which driven by our community themselves!

Check out the full changelist below:

[u][h1]Patch Notes[/h1][/u]

[h2]What's New[/h2]

[list]
[*] A variety of new hats are now available to keep up with the ever changing duck fashion scene
[*] New mission areas: Port and Missile Silo
[*] Beta players can redeem an exclusive hat 
[*] Toolboxes can be found around the map and searched for loot
[*] New flying mechanic - sprinting near the ground consumes less stamina
[*] New Weapon: “Hunter Pistol” which consumes rifle ammo
[*] Send feathers flying with new explosive ammo
[*] Triangular foundations and floors have been added 
[*] New: Vertical hatch doors and double doors
[*] Blueprints for flashlight and holosight items can now be found throughout the world
[*] Players can now repair their buildings
[*] PVE Servers have been implemented
[*] Added a “comfort” level when ducks are inside the house when they can be healed over time
[/list]

[h2]General Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] Game now displays the amount of time before base your decays
[*] Added Camp Site near the small monument
[*] Reworked the Factory location, making it more challenging
[*] Added “last code” shortcut to door codes
[*] Added Option to Mute Chat
[*] Added labels to nests on the map
[*] Players can now rename and delete nests from the map
[*] “Free to use” furnaces can be found around the map
[*] Fiber can now be gathered from berry bushes
[*] Added Quick Craft shortcuts to the craft menu
[*] Items can now be delivered in inventory one by one when multi-crafting same item
[*] Added option for higher level workbenches to craft lower level workbench items.
[*] Train carts can be exploded which allows you to scavenge resources
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Item stacks increased
[*] Slightly altered how items are shown when worn by the duck
[*] Added visual effects to fully charged bows
[*] Various research prices were decreased
[*] Nest health points reduced
[*] Change interact keybinding without breaking recycler
[*] Players now see if they do not have enough feathers to buy things in vending machine
[*] Items that can be used or placed now move to Quick Bar Slots after crafting
[*] Other 
minor improvements
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed items spawning wrong in front of the recycler when this was full
[*] Fixed the research table not disassembling
[*] Fixed an issue where the hat would change after the character's death
[*] Fixed and issue where changing default F interact button to default E interact button would break active recycler process
[*] Fixed an issue where items are picked up from the floor when opening doors or crates.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0uXkJC.gif[/img]

Don't forget to join the conversation over on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]Discord[/url] and keep up to date with all things DUCKSIDE by following us on social media:
[i][list]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayDUCKSIDE/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDUCKSIDE]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/playduckside/]Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Duckside/]Reddit[/url]
[/list][/i]

Over the course of the Beta we will be regularly wiping the servers to ensure stability, accessibility for new players and to provide a regular fresh experience for players. Please see below the current wipe schedule 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/b1d235c2da456e2a27c89ae83b2cbe093bdc063d.png[/img]

notes.title: DUCKSIDE FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899335/4ac91e993c91cdd82872abad75d91dce0219bc98.jpg[/img]

[quote]We've received a duck-ton of questions from players since we announced DUCKSIDE early in April and since our recent beta ended, so today we're going to answer some of the most common questions that have been filling our inboxes of late![/quote]

[b]What is DUCKSIDE?[/b]

Imagine DayZ or Rust but you're a duck. DUCKSIDE is a persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat wearing ducks, wielding weapons.

[b]Is this a real game?[/b]

The game is as real as the feathers on your wings, or if you’re one of those unsettling featherless creatures, the tears of joy that fill your eyes after witnessing our wonderful trailer or having played the previous beta.

In short, yes, this is a very real game.

[b]What are the minimum and recommended system specs to run DUCKSIDE?[/b]

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Minimum:[/th]
        [th]Recommended:[/th]
  [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]OS *: 64-bit Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11[/td]
        [td]OS *: 64-bit Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10 +[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Processor: Intel i5 4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G[/td]
        [td]Processor: Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Memory: 8 GB RAM[/td]
        [td]Memory: 16 GB RAM[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]Graphics: GTX 960[/td]
        [td]Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]DirectX: Version 11[/td]
        [td]DirectX: Version 11[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]Storage: 25 GB available space[/td]
        [td]Storage: 25 GB available space[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]Will DUCKSIDE be free?[/b]

No, DUCKSIDE will be a paid game, with the pricing still to be decided. However, the Open Betas are free and we invite you all to join and help us improve the game ahead of launch!

[b]When will we be able to play a beta?[/b]

We’re recruiting new ducks to join us in our Beta which starts on the 6th of June.

[b]How do I sign up for the beta?[/b]

You can sign up here - https://tblink.co/JoinTheFlock 

[b]Is there anything new in the June 6th Beta?[/b]

The beta will include significant balancing adjustments and other improvements alongside a number of new features, cosmetics, and more. We have even more major updates planned to come to the game over the course of the beta too, so stay tuned for news!

We are still yet to decide on the length of the playtest, but we’ll have more news on this soon.

notes.title: 100k players have joined the flock!
notes.content:
Quack.

I will just start saying Quack instead of Hello Everyone. 

100k DUCKS! 

We have just crossed 100,000 sign-ups for the beta! To think this was all April Fools, eh? 

GAME PERFORMANCE (silky smooth)

These are incredible numbers and way beyond our expectations. Thank you for sticking around through the turbulent server-restarting-wiping-crashing weekend. Yesterday's wipe and player density tweaks have actually helped server performance drastically. As of the moment of making this post, we are seeing smooth performance across the board. 

WIPE SCHEDULES

While the servers are fine right now, we cannot accurately predict when issues start emerge. We are monitoring numbers of entities on servers to see where the breaking points are. The team is working hard on server-side optimizations. So right now the wipe schedule is TBD. Unless we get serious performance issues, or a game update that actually requires a wipe, you should be good for now.

UPCOMING FEATURES WOO

I got a chance to sitdown with the team today and talk about the upcoming pipeline and priorities. Some of these will be more immediate than others, and our aim is to get as many updates as possible during the beta. So here is a bulletpoint list of things we're working on, in no particular order

- Network optimization. It is vital we get the servers to transfer less data in an optimal way.
- Base upkeep / decay. We're working on a system that requires you to put FEATHERS into your IDOL that if drained will make your base decay. This will help with abandoned bases just standing around there. It will also allow for interesting heist opportunities from decayed bases so new players have a chance of hitting it big on a recently decayed base.
- TIER1 visual rework. Right now our visual for tier1 feels too "safe", so it can be annoying when you feel safe, get a few workbenches in and someone with a hatchet busts through your wall. The solution we are aiming for is gaps in the tier1 building blocks, so light shines through, other players can see through, and it's visually obvious you're not safe. We are also playing with the balance of melee tools to tier1 building objects. 
- Map size. We are working on adding more zones to the map. This will be a fine balancing act of player density at spawn, points of interest, and zones where players can feel safer and build up. 

These are just a few things out of a long todo list alongside bugs, exploits, etc that the team is working tirelessly on. 

Can't thank you all enough for the support. 

for the flock!

- Alex & team tinyBuild

notes.title: WIPE #2, server update, blueprints stay
notes.content:
A good day to everyone in the flock!

We are initiating the second wipe at around the time of this update. Yesterday's wipe helped us identify a few core issues. 

If you experienced lag, in a nutshell the reason for it is a combination of 3 factors: too many players, too many bases, and too many active NPCs. One of these at a time the servers handle no problem. When you have 2, it becomes a slight issue. When you have all 3 - that's when the game becomes unplayable.

The fixes for these 3 are fairly straightforward and require a bit of development time, which the team is working on right now.

A temporary fix to the issues is reducing player density. This is what today's wipe will achieve. We've received a lot of feedback that high pop servers are a bit too much chaos, so we hit 2 ducks with one stone here. After today's wipe, the max player count will be slightly reduced. 

- Bases and loot will be wiped
- Blueprints WILL NOT BE WIPED. You keep your blueprint progression.

Through the upcoming week we will be working on client fixes to optimize traffic (so that NPCs and players don't strangle server performance) and we are working on figuring out base decay. The issue we have now is that abandoned bases do not despawn, so I appreciate the community coming together yesterday to "clean" servers from dead bases. There will be a system to address this issue, most likely in the form of base decay. 

Please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/2umax49Zvu]DISCORD[/url] or on the forums what you think about the new player density, and we will see you in-game!

notes.title: FIRST WIPE and general update on the flock
notes.content:
Greetings from the flock!

First off an enormous, heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who joined the beta so far. We have over 85k players right now. This is way beyond our expectations. 

On Thursday we had to panic increase the amount of game servers. By about 5 times. That was a fun night.

We did a couple of hotfixes to both the server and the client. There's an enormous backlog we're working on.

Today we wiped all servers. The goal of the test was to see stability of game servers, understand what kind of issues we get at scale. This was the reason to wipe said servers, because we finally reached the critical point in terms of the amount of buildings on any given server. Usually persistent world games like this have a wipe schedule, which we couldn't anticipate going into the beta. So today's wipe will help us understand how the map size works with player density, alongside the max player cap per server.

Immediate points of focus are:

- Network optimization, so you players experience smooth movement when servers fill up with more players
- Exploit fixes, i.e. clipping through walls and getting loot
- Balance fixes, such as not all players understanding that tier1 is actually easy to raid. Yes, much like many of you I've seen a lot of bases with tier3 workbenches and not upgraded walls. A simple solution here is to decrease the damage done by melee weapons to tier1 walls, and also make tier1 walls "look" much less safe, i.e. have see-through gaps. 

We are seeing and gathering all the feedback provided. The simplest way to report issues / share feedback is right here on the Steam Forums or on our super active DISCORD. 

Thank you
- Team tinyBuild
